title: Elihu Speaks: God Is Mighty

questions.question: Bear with me a little, and I will show you, for I have yet something to say on whose behalf?
questions.explanation: Job 36:2 (ESV): "Bear with me a little, and I will show you, for I have yet something to say on God's behalf."

questions.question: I will get my knowledge from afar and ascribe what to my Maker?
questions.explanation: Job 36:3 (ESV): "I will get my knowledge from afar and ascribe righteousness to my Maker."

questions.question: For truly my words are not false; one who is perfect in what is with you?
questions.explanation: Job 36:4 (ESV): "For truly my words are not false; one who is perfect in knowledge is with you."

questions.question: Behold, God is mighty, and does not despise any; he is mighty in strength of what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:5 (ESV): "Behold, God is mighty, and does not despise any; he is mighty in strength of understanding."

questions.question: He does not keep the wicked alive, but gives the afflicted their what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:6 (ESV): "He does not keep the wicked alive, but gives the afflicted their right."

questions.question: He does not withdraw his eyes from the what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:7 (ESV): "He does not withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings upon the throne he sets them forever..."

questions.question: If they are bound in chains and caught in the cords of affliction, then he declares to them their what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:9 (ESV): "then he declares to them their work and their transgressions, that they are behaving arrogantly."

questions.question: He opens their ear to instruction and commands that they return from what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:10 (ESV): "He opens their ear to instruction and commands that they return from iniquity."

questions.question: If they listen and serve him, they complete their days in what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:11 (ESV): "If they listen and serve him, they complete their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasantness."

questions.question: But if they do not listen, they perish by the sword and die without what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:12 (ESV): "But if they do not listen, they perish by the sword and die without knowledge."

questions.question: The godless in heart cherish anger; they do not cry for help when he does what to them?
questions.explanation: Job 36:13 (ESV): "The godless in heart cherish anger; they do not cry for help when he binds them."

questions.question: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ear by what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:15 (ESV): "He delivers the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ear by adversity."

questions.question: Take care; do not turn to iniquity, for this you have chosen rather than what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:21 (ESV): "Take care; do not turn to iniquity, for this you have chosen rather than affliction."

questions.question: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; the number of his years is what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:26 (ESV): "Behold, God is great, and we know him not; the number of his years is unsearchable."

questions.question: For he draws up the drops of water; they distill his mist in what?
questions.explanation: Job 36:27 (ESV): "For he draws up the drops of water; they distill his mist in rain,"

key_verse_text: Behold, God is mighty, and does not despise any; he is mighty in strength of understanding.
